data.title: 玛露希尔 · 蘑菇图鉴的争论
data.description: 营地，她摊着手绘的蘑菇图鉴与同伴争论某种菌类的可食性，手指点着插图据理力争；最后以「吃了看看就知道了（不是我吃）」收场。
data.action: 营地，她摊着手绘的蘑菇图鉴与同伴争论某种菌类的可食性，手指点着插图据理力争
data.promptProse: Marcille leans over the table in her blue robe, a finger on a drawing in the open mushroom guide as her long blond braid falls forward. A short-haired companion in a rust-brown travel vest listens from across the table, holding the other side of the notebook. Lantern light catches the indignant elf's face and the page between them.
data.animaCaption: Blond elven Marcille in blue points at the mushroom drawing. Her short dark-haired human companion in a rust-brown travel vest holds the opposite corner of the notebook.
